finalText:
Build's clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw.

Fixed both: `options.js` now reads `retryCount`, and `retryPolicy.js` treats `undefined` as backoff disabled. Ran `node build.js`, it finishes clean with exit code 0.
